guidance.eligibilityNarrative: USDA single-family guaranteed purchase path for eligible rural/suburban areas with household-income limits and primary-occupancy requirements.
keyRequirements: Property must be in USDA-eligible geography at time of decision.
Household income must meet applicable USDA limits for area/household size.
Primary occupancy and agency underwriting requirements apply.
documentationExpectations: USDA eligibility report (address + household income check).
Income package including household member income considerations.
Guarantee fee and annual fee disclosure calculations.
edgeCases: Boundary properties where eligibility map updates change status.
commonDenialReasons: Property in ineligible area at time of underwriting.
Overlay credit/DTI restrictions exceed baseline USDA tolerance.
overlayCaveats: Many investors require minimum credit overlays above agency minimum assumptions.
Manual underwrite and reserve overlays are common.
compensatingFactors: Verified reserves and stable repayment profile.
Lower DTI after accurate household-income treatment.
workflowNotes: Run USDA area/income eligibility at intake and before final approval.
Document household-income logic for QC clarity.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: USDA streamlined assist refinance for existing USDA borrowers, emphasizing payment benefit and seasoning/payment-history requirements.
keyRequirements: Required payment reduction/benefit tests must be met.
Program seasoning and payment-history thresholds apply.
documentationExpectations: Current USDA loan profile and payment history.
edgeCases: Short seasoning windows near eligibility threshold.
overlayCaveats: Some investors apply stricter payment-history overlays than agency minimums.
Credit overlays may still apply on streamline executions.
compensatingFactors: Strong payment history and clear monthly savings.
Stable occupancy and reduced risk profile.
workflowNotes: Retain clear benefit-test documentation in file.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: USDA streamlined standard refinance for eligible existing USDA borrowers requiring broader qualification support than assist paths.
keyRequirements: Existing USDA path eligibility and acceptable payment history.
Income/asset/credit documentation per current policy and lender execution path.
Primary occupancy and property eligibility checks remain required.
documentationExpectations: Payment history and payoff profile support.
commonDenialReasons: Qualification profile outside policy or investor overlay tolerance.
overlayCaveats: Investors commonly add reserves/DTI overlays to standard streamlined paths.
Credit overlays may be tighter than agency baseline assumptions.
compensatingFactors: Strong reserves and low payment shock.
Improved monthly obligation and stable income trend.
workflowNotes: Validate eligibility map and occupancy near final approval.
Capture full qualification audit trail for overlays.
